description: React component for the Channel Notifications Modal in Mattermost, managing notification settings for channels including mute, ignore mentions, desktop and mobile notifications, and thread follow options.

methods.name: ChannelNotificationsModal
methods.description: Main React component rendering the notification settings modal for a channel.

methods.name: getStateFromNotifyProps
methods.description: Initializes notification settings state from user and channel notify props.

methods.name: getInitialValuesOfChannelNotifyProps
methods.description: Determines initial notification property values based on defaults, channel, and user notify props.

methods.name: getInitialValuesOfIgnoreChannelMentions
methods.description: Calculates initial ignore mentions setting based on current notification levels and user preferences.

methods.name: createChannelNotifyPropsFromSelectedSettings
methods.description: Creates channel notify props object from user-selected notification settings.

methods.name: areDesktopAndMobileSettingsDifferent
methods.description: Checks if desktop and mobile notification settings differ, considering thread collapse.
